newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean defector to leave Beijing on Tuesday -TV.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean defector to leave Beijing on Tuesday -TV.

text.p: North Korea's top ideologue has left South Korea's Beijing mission and is preparing to leave for a third country, Yonhap Television News reported on Tuesday.

Yonhap said Hwang Jang-yop was due to fly to an unidentified third country later on Tuesday for a month-long stay before travelling to South Korea. A foreign ministry spokesman declined comment on the report.
Later, Yonhap quoted a government source as saying Hwang had already left China.
The foreign ministry spokesman said China and South Korea would announce Hwang's departure after he had left Beijing.
South Korea's influential Chosun Ilbo newspaper said Hwang and an aide who sought asylum with him slipped out of South Korea's consulate overnight.
On Monday a senior South Korean official said Hwang would stay in a third country "for a considerable period of time" before coming to South Korea.
